jobs.title: Staff Inbound Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**The role**

ServiceNow is looking for an Inbound Product Manager to make Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) easy to start and easy to expand across the enterprise. You’ll own two product areas that drive adoption of the SPM suite.

**Time to Value** helps new customers complete setup faster with less hands-on help. It also gives executives a view of where SPM is delivering value over time and where to focus next.

**Enterprise-Wide Deployment** lets established customers scale one SPM instance across multiple business units while keeping common governance and allowing controlled differences in data access, user experience, and process.

As an inbound product manager, you’ll own what gets built in these areas from problem definition through release. You’ll work directly with engineering, customers, and partner product teams to decide what to build and in what order. Adoption and expansion are how SPM grows within our customer base, so this role has significant visibility and direct impact on that growth.

**What you’ll do**

* Own Time to Value. Define the vision and roadmap for capabilities that get new customers through setup faster with less hands-on help, and that show executives where SPM is delivering value and where to focus next.
* Own Enterprise-Wide Deployment. Define the vision and roadmap for capabilities that make it simple for customers to extend SPM to new business units while keeping governance consistent.
* Rethink adoption with AI. Find new ways for AI to help customers plan, implement, and adopt SPM, including implementation agents that take on setup work customers and partners do by hand today.
* Coordinate across the portfolio. Partner with adjacent product teams on how they adopt these capabilities, so changes land cleanly across products.
* Build with customers. Run discovery with customers, partners, and field teams to find and prioritize the problems worth solving, and turn what you learn into clear requirements engineering can build against.
* Measure what matters. Define success metrics for setup speed, value realized, adoption, and expansion, track them after release, and use the results to shape what comes next.
* Make the case. Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, and roadmap priorities to executive, technical, and customer audiences.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8+ years of software product management experience shipping enterprise products
* Experience writing requirements, building roadmaps, and partnering with engineering on feasibility
* Executive presence: experience presenting plans and positions to senior leaders, and earning alignment even when you’re pushing back
* Execution excellence: a record of delivering high-quality, scalable capabilities quickly
* Customer obsession: the ability to turn complex customer needs into simple solutions
* Data-driven mindset: using qualitative and quantitative insights to guide decisions and measure success
* Strategic problem-solving: comfort with ambiguity and a habit of finding the root problem
* Experience with portfolio, project, or resource management products, or with the ServiceNow platform, is a plus
* Experience with onboarding, setup automation, or value measurement is a plus

FD21

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control auth…

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I
jobs.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Team’s Impact**
=================

**Commercial and Markets Distribution** engineering team focused on developing cutting-edge integration pipelines that drive the business forward through innovative solutions. We leverage modern front-end and backend technologies to build scalable and highly performant web platforms. The challenge, scope, and versatility of this development work provide an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and client offerings.

Join our dynamic team and contribute to building robust, reliable, and scalable applications using Python , AWS , ETL Pipelines and Vue JS Framework. Our applications shape the user's experience and drive FactSet's growth through technological innovations.

  

**What You’II Do**
==================

* Maintain and resolve bugs in existing components
* Contribute new features, fixes, and refactors to the existing code
* Perform code reviews and coach engineers with respect to best practices
* Work with other engineers in following the test-driven methodology in an agile environment
* Collaborate with other engineers and Product Developers in a Scrum Agile environment using Jira and Confluence
* Ability to work as part of a geographically diverse team
* Ability to create and review documentation and test plans
* Estimate task sizes and regularly communicate progress in daily standups and biweekly Scrum meetings
Coordinate with other teams across offices and departments  

**What We’re Looking For**
==========================

* Engineering computer science Bachelor’s degree required
* We are looking for **2-3 years of Total experience in Fullstack Development** for this role.
* Good technical, collaborative, troubleshooting, and communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of **Python programming**
* Understanding of **OOP concepts, data structures, and algorithms**
* Experience with frameworks such as **Django / Flask / FastAPI**
* Build responsive and interactive UI components using **Vue.js** or relevant JavaScript frameworks
* Relational database experience, preferably with POSTGRES
* Experience with Github-based development processes
* Working experience on AWS services, Lambda, EC2, S3, AWS Glue etc.
* Experience building and deploying production level services
Organized, self-directed, and resourceful with the ability to appropriately prioritize work in a fast-paced environment  

  
  

**Nice to have skills**
=======================

* Experience with **AI/ML libraries** (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn)
* Understanding of **Docker / CI-CD pipelines**
Familiar with Agile software development (Scrum is a plus).  

  

**What's In It For You**
========================

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.

* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.

* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.

* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.

* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.

* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Release Manager
jobs.description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Artificial Intelligence  
Company Name: Brillio

Seniority level: Mid-Senior Level

  

Min Experience: 5+ years  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, Pune, Maharashtra, India, Hyderabad, Telangana, India  
JobType: full-time

The Release Manager oversees and executes release management activities to ensure successful, seamless code deployments across all lower and production environments. This is a hands-on role requiring a technical expert who will maintain robust CI/CD pipelines while actively collaborating with multiple teams to deliver artifacts on time. By enforcing established SDLC release processes, troubleshooting deployment failures, and managing clear client communications, you will ensure high-quality software delivery and operational stability.

**Requirements**
----------------

Key Responsibilities

* Manage Deployments: Coordinate and execute end-to-end release management activities to ensure successful code deployment across lower and production environments.

* Pipeline Engineering: Maintain automated CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment workflows, optimize delivery speed, and reduce manual errors.

* Process Enforcement: Enforce established SDLC release processes, governance models, and deployment protocols across all internal teams and client stakeholders.

* Cross-Team Liaison: Partner actively with multiple development, engineering, and product teams to track dependencies and ensure all release artifacts are delivered on time.

* Troubleshoot Failures: Diagnose and troubleshoot complex CI/CD pipeline and deployment failures rapidly, recommending and implementing permanent technical fixes.

* Client Communication: Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, providing clear, transparent updates regarding release schedules, risks, and deployment statuses. Required Qualifications

* CI/CD Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines using GitLab and GitHub.

* Data Stack Familiarity: Hands-on experience managing and executing code deployments specifically for Snowflake, Apache Airflow, and DBT.

* SDLC Knowledge: Deep understanding of the standard Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and release management methodologies.

* Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a proven track record of successful client-facing communication and stakeholder management.

* Problem Solving: Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate infrastructure, pipeline, or code configuration failures under tight release deadlines. Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working within cloud data warehouse environments or data engineering release tracks.

* Certification in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or relevant cloud/DevOps practices.

* Experience managing releases in multi-tenant or complex enterprise client ecosystems.

  

**Must-have skills**
--------------------

GitLab, GitHub, CI/CD

**Good-to-have skills**
-----------------------

Cloud data warehouse, Data engineering, Git Lab certification

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Business Onsite Buying Experience
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Business Onsite Buying Experience team owns the end-to-end Amazon Business website and mobile experience, enabling customers to (1) discover products and features via the business homepage, navigation, and search, (2) purchase through search, detail page, cart, and checkout, (3) track, manage, and reconcile purchases post-purchase, and (4) get help through conversational AI via Alexa for Shopping and Amazon Business Assistant.  
  
We are looking for a senior product leader to own the innovation and growth in one or more feature areas within the charter with innovative, relevant and personalized solutions tailored to business user personas. This product leader sets a long-term vision for the assigned area, ensures alignment with overall Amazon Business vision and creates and executes the roadmap to improve customer experience with new features and experiments.  
  
The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels in dealing with significant ambiguity and has keen interest in business procurement experience that is vastly complex with multiple user roles, groups, entities, and thousands of users for each customer. He/she will possess strong analytical capabilities, stellar verbal and written communication skills, thorough understanding of e-commerce consumer behavior and purchase funnels, and drive to rapidly test/learn/iterate mentality. The product leader also brings strong collaborative skills and ability to engage leaders from technical teams, go-to-market teams (sales, customer support, and professional services), and UX/customer research teams to communicate and/or draw insights on customer needs/pain points and drive consensus on investments.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Execute on the current roadmap and constantly evaluate the prioritization to make maximum impact of available bandwidth.  
2. Define three year product vision for the assigned areas that is a complement to the overall AB vision to serve different customer segments - from SMBs to Enterprises - on both desktop and mobile.  
3. Create a roadmap that meets current and future requirements for Amazon Business customer segments, such as enterprise, SMB and Micro segments.  
4. Work with other product managers in Amazon Business to ensure their roadmap and vision are aligned with a focus on cohesive experiences and reusable UX components/patterns. Own Northstar metrics for assigned feature area(s).  
5. Work with engineering teams to build scalable solutions that enable rapid experimentation and incremental optimization on a continuous basis once the initial solutions are delivered.  
6. Partner closely with other AB feature teams, go-to-market teams, UX/customer research teams, and Retail teams to deliver features in the assigned feature areas within the buying journey.  
7. Be the interface and subject matter expert for your assigned feature areas, create and nurture relationships with other AB feature teams and retail teams.  
8. Contribute to tech strategy of your features and provide guidance to tech teams to come up with future-proof designs.  
9. Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

jobs.title: Product Manager, GenAI Products (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Techdome is a product engineering company that helps enterprises move from “we should use AI” to AI running reliably in production. Our cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and AI specialists build LLM applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Everything we ship comes with the security, integrations, and compliance that enterprise buyers require.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
A GenAI demo is easy to build. A GenAI product that passes a security audit, stays within budget, keeps cost per query under control, and earns the trust of its users is not.
  
  
We’re hiring a Product Manager who wants to own that second problem. You’ll take products from the first client conversation through launch and growth, and you’ll be the one who catches the fuzzy requirement, the dropped handoff, or the hidden risk while it’s still cheap to fix.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Define the product**

* Turn a client’s raw idea into a clear product definition with realistic scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets.
* Learn each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and translate them into requirements engineers can build from without guessing.

**Get GenAI into production**

* Work with ML engineers to turn LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, and safe systems.
* Set and monitor the production metrics that matter: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query.
* Ensure every AI feature integrates with client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, data privacy, and uptime.

**Align the team**

* Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so every handoff is explicit.
* Plan capacity and hold all parties to their commitments.
* Manage relationships with third-party partners, including LLM and cloud providers.

**Manage risk and communication**

* Run formal change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget moves.
* Raise delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early, including hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and cost overruns.
* Track delivery in JIRA or Azure DevOps and keep clients and leadership informed with no surprises.
* Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

What You Bring
  
  
**Required**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having launched an LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a working understanding of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and of tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Good judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including with senior client executives.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Domain expertise in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Cross-industry experience and the curiosity to learn a new domain quickly.

Your First 90 Days
  
  

* Days 1–30: Learn how Techdome delivers, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.
* Days 31–60: Independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, risks, and client relationship.
* Days 61–90: Land a key milestone, make a visible improvement to how we run projects, and earn the trust of your team and clients.

Why Join Us
  
  

* Technically demanding GenAI work across several industries.
* Daily collaboration with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* A real voice in how projects are planned, run, and delivered.
* The chance to build deep expertise at the frontier of GenAI.

Senior Product Manager – Skolasti

Location: Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

**About Skolasti**

Skolasti is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for running an online academy. Each customer gets their own branded academy, with its own domain, coaches, courses, learners, payments and certificates, all on shared infrastructure that we operate.

The academy is the core unit, and it scales with the customer. A solo coach can launch one in an afternoon. A training business can run it with a team of coaches. An institution can run several programs, cohorts and roles inside it. The product is built for that whole range, and growing customers along it is a big part of this job.

We host live and recorded courses with DRM-protected delivery, assessments, certification, learner engagement, analytics and AI-assisted learning. We have the platform. Now we need someone to turn it into a growing SaaS business.

**The role**

You will own Skolasti as a business, not just its roadmap. You'll be accountable for how many academies sign up, how many become paying, how fast they get value, how long they stay, and how much they grow.

This is a hands-on, senior role. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO and a small engineering team, with no layers of product management in between. You decide what we build and why, and you prove it worked with numbers.

**The metrics you will own:**

* Acquisition to activation: signup-to-live-academy rate, time to first course published, time to first paid enrolment
* Conversion: Trial-to-paid, plan mix, self-serve vs sales-assisted
* Retention: logo churn, revenue churn, net revenue retention (NRR)
* Expansion: upgrades, add-ons, seat and coach growth, usage-based revenue
* Tenant health: feature adoption, learner activity per academy, early churn signals

**What you'll own**

**Strategy and segments**

* Define who we win with along the academy range: solo creators, multi-coach academies, institutions. Shape the product and pricing so customers can move upthat range without leaving us.
* Know the competition well, including Teachable, Thinkific, Kajabi, Graphy and institutional LMS players, and decide where we differentiate and where we don't.

**Pricing and packaging**

* Own plans, tiers, feature gating, usage limits, add-ons and trials.
* Run pricing experiments and measure their effect on conversion, ARPA and churn.
* Work with engineering on billing and subscription flows (Chargebee) and plan entitlements.

**Self-serve funnel and onboarding**

* Own the path from signup to a live academy, then to first course published, then to first learner paying.
* Remove friction until a new academy owner gets value without talking to us.

**Retention and expansion**

* Build tenant health scoring and act on early churn signals.
* Design the path from solo academy to multi-coach academy to institution: roles, permissions, seats, white-labeling, custom domains, SSO.

**Platform and ecosystem**

* Prioritise admin, APIs, webhooks and integrations (video, payments, CRM, marketing tools) that make Skolasti the system of record for an academy.

**AI features**

* Define AI-assisted learning and creator tools with clear value to the customer.
* Own their unit economics: what each AI feature costs per tenant, what we meter, and which plans include it.

**Discovery, data and delivery**

* Talk to academy owners, coaches and learners every week, not just when collecting requirements.
* Instrument the product, own the dashboards, and make decisions from funnel and cohort data.
* Write crisp problem statements and PRDs, prioritise ruthlessly against business impact, and ship with engineering in short cycles.
* Partner with marketing, sales and customer success on positioning, launches and feedback loops.

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days**

1. Interview at least 20 academy owners across segments, including some who churned.
2. Stand up a metrics baseline: funnel, activation, conversion, churn and NRR, with dashboards the whole team uses.
3. Present a point of view on our primary segment, pricing and the top three product bets, backed by data.
4. Ship at least one measurable improvement to signup-to-live-academy activation.

**First year**

* A repackaged pricing model in market, with its impact on conversion and ARPA measured.
* Activation and trial-to-paid materially up from baseline.
* A clear upgrade path from solo academy to multi-coach academy to institution, with expansion revenue tracked.
* A product rhythm of discovery, prioritisation and delivery that runs without the CEO in every decision.

**Must-haves**

* 4+ years owning a B2B SaaS product end-to-end, with revenue, conversion or retention outcomes you can quote.
* Has shipped pricing, packaging or monetisation changes and measured the result.
* Fluent in SaaS metrics, including MRR/ARR, churn, NRR, CAC/LTV, activation and cohort analysis. Comfortable pulling your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool such as Mix panel / OpenPanel, Amplitude or PostHog).
* Has driven a self-serve or product-led funnel, or a clear path from self-serve to sales-assisted.
* Understands multi-tenant platforms: tenant admin, roles and permissions, configuration vs customisation, and the cost of one-off customer requests.
* Technical enough to have real trade-off conversations with engineers about architecture, scale and cost.
* Has worked as the only PM, or one of very few, in a small team, and is comfortable doing their own discovery, analysis, writing and launch work.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience in EdTech, LMS, creator platforms or online course businesses. We valuestrong SaaS fundamentals over domain knowledge.

Within TA, the **Dealer Services / Main Office Services (MOS)** team acts as a critical interface between fund managers, intermediaries, distributors, platforms, and internal operations teams. Data Product owns consumer needs, prioritization, business definitions, requirements, acceptance criteria, and adoption. We partner closely with Data Solutions, which owns technical architecture and implementation, and Data Operations, which owns production support.

7+ Years

Business Analysis – Data Governance

* Analyse database access controls, user privileges and audit requirements and translate business needs into functional requirements.
* Support metadata management, data lineage, data quality and data stewardship initiatives.
* Work with Collibra, Informatica or Alation to support governance workflows, metadata documentation and stewardship activities.
* Prepare BRDs, FRDs, process flows, assessment reports, functional specifications and requirement traceability documents.
* Coordinate with technical teams to validate governance requirements and ensure successful implementation.
* Track governance issues, risks, action items and remediation activities.

**Mandatory Skills**

1. **Overall Experience:**
   7+ years, ideally beginning as a DBA or Data Engineer and subsequently transitioning into Data Governance or Data Stewardship.
2. **Business Analysis:**
   Strong experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, workshops, assessments, gap analysis and documentation.
3. **Database Knowledge:**
   Hands-on experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL.
4. **Database Security:**
   Practical understanding of database privileges, roles, access controls and auditing.
5. **Data Governance Tools:**
   Experience with at least one of the following:

* Collibra
* Informatica
* Alation

1. **Data Governance:**
   Knowledge of data ownership, data stewardship, metadata management, data lineage and data quality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare or other regulated industries.
* Exposure to GxP, regulatory compliance and audit requirements.
* Experience conducting enterprise data governance assessments.
* Ability to work with DBA, Data Engineering, Security, Compliance and Business teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A technically strong Business Analyst who started their career as a DBA or Data Engineer and transitioned into Data Governance or Data Stewardship. The candidate must be capable of understanding database-level controls while independently conducting stakeholder workshops, gathering requirements, performing assessments and translating governance needs into functional specifications.

jobs.description:
About Bazaarvoice

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.

The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.

Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

### **Job Description**

Influenster is the product-passionate member community at the heart of Bazaarvoice’s Consumer Acquisition & Sampling (CAS) business. Members discover products, try samples, and share honest reviews that power brand campaigns. The CAS Fundamentals team owns the core member experience that keeps this community healthy: onboarding, identity, trust, discovery, and the everyday reasons members come back.

As the Senior Product Manager for CAS Fundamentals, you will keep members happy, engaged, and coming back to Influenster. You will own the strategy and roadmap for the foundational member experience across web and app, and you will balance member delight with the legal, compliance, and data-quality foundations that make our campaigns work for brands.

### **How you’ll make an impact**

* Define the strategy and a 1–2 year roadmap for the Influenster member experience, with clear ownership of the CAS Fundamentals KPIs:

  + Monthly Active Members on Influenster
* Own the core member journey end to end, including:

  + Onboarding and activation
  + Member identity
  + Feed and search
  + App integration
  + Localization
  + Legal and compliance requirements
* Drive engagement and organic content growth and run experiments to grow the volume and richness of organic content.
* Discover and validate problems through member research, funnel and cohort analysis, and experimentation. Turn them into prioritized, well-scoped bets.
* Balance competing investments: member growth and engagement, trust and compliance, and the content inventory that supports brand campaigns.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Legal, Marketing, and other CAS teams to ensure aligned backlogs and that engineering has what it needs to size, build, and ship.
* Own the full product lifecycle from discovery and build through launch, measurement, and iteration. Communicate outcomes with data-driven narratives that connect member engagement to business results.
* Stay close to the market: community, creator, and loyalty-app trends, plus the competitive landscape for consumer review and product-sampling experiences.

### **Essential Criteria**

* Experience building and scaling mobile apps in a D2C setting (helpful)
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in consumer-facing products where engagement and retention are core metrics (communities, marketplaces, loyalty, social, or content platforms).
* Strong ownership of engagement metrics (MAU, retention, activation) and the ability to design and analyze experiments to move them.
* Experience with foundational consumer product areas such as onboarding, identity and account systems, feed or search, and localization.
* Ability to work through legal, privacy, and compliance requirements (consent, data handling, verification) without losing sight of member experience.
* Comfort with data: you define success metrics, run analyses, and use product analytics tools to make decisions.
* Ability to prioritize across competing goals and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a multi-sided environment serving members, brands, and retailers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of working closely with engineering and design.

**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Manager Product Control.**

**Purpose of the role**

Product Control is part of Controllership. Product Control ensures traded products are fair valued, correctly accounted and disclosed with prudent valuations, reported to our regulators and Management. We also partner with the business to achieve sustainable financial performance. The Product Control Global Service Centre team is responsible for end-to-end product control tasks including but not limited to preparation, analysis, and reporting of Profit & Loss and Profit & Loss attribution, to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger and balance sheet. The individual will be responsible for handling end-to-end Product Control processes for the European / Middle East Sites.

**In this role, you will:**

* To act as an individual contributor delivering Profit & Loss production, analysis & commentaries, Profit & Loss, and Balance Sheet Reconciliations & substantiation, and have sound knowledge of products, valuation, and reporting activities pertaining to Global Markets business.
* Demonstrate a sound understanding of Markets business and processes. Observance to Group policies, audit, controls, and compliance requirements including but not limited to declaration of secrecy, data protection act, health, safety and security, information security, clear desk policy
* Responsible for ensuring that the delivery service of Finance Product Control processes per the standards set out in agreed SLAs within the HSBC Global Resourcing operating framework considering key operational risks and ways to mitigate them and operating a well-defined control environment.
* Responsible for ensuring that the Product Controls are aligned to the Global standards and highlight in case of deviation.
* Continually assess the operational risks inherent in the processes, taking account of changing operating procedures, staff movements, legal and regulatory requirements, management restructures, and the impact of new technology.
* Undertake measures to initiate and implement high-impact quality projects leading to operational efficiency and higher productivity (Within Six Sigma, Lean process improvement methodology)
* Undertake continuous review of processes with the objective of improving the service delivery timeframes and identifying areas of improvement.
* Responsible for ensuring BCP (business continuity plan) is documented, agreed and tested as per agreed timelines.Manage Product control processes in accordance with the group’s reporting requirements

**To be successful you will:**

* University degree from a reputable institution with minimum 2 years of experience in related fields (i.e., Product Control, Valuations, etc)
* Experience in partnering with senior stakeholders, and handling conflicts
* Understanding of financial markets products (i.e. debt securities, money markets instruments, Foreign Exchange (FX) swaps, Interest Rates Swaps, Cross Currency Swaps, etc). This entails the understanding of valuation techniques, associated risk sensitivities (i.e. Greeks), and risk factor Profit & Loss analysis
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience in driving project implementation

* Understanding and/or experience in Treasury business
* Understanding and/or experience in Hedge Accounting. Experience with accounting controls for Financial Instruments
* Knowledge and experience with a programming language (i.e. VBA, Python, SQL, C++, etc). Professional qualifications such as MBA, CA, CFA, FRM, etc,

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About the Role
  
As part of the Digital Experience / Enterprise Website Initiative (EWI) team, you will own the product vision, roadmap and technical direction for Lilly’s global marketing and corporate websites. This is a fast-paced role that needs flexibility, sound product judgment and the agility to balance many markets and priorities at once.
  
This role combines three jobs in one person. You are the technical product owner for your affiliates’ web initiatives and sites, deciding what and how it gets built and why. You are the trusted partner to affiliates and website owners, translating their business goals into products that work. And you are a forward deployed engineer: highly technical, close to the business, and ready to roll up your sleeves and solve core engineering problems yourself. You bring a strong working understanding of the Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) platform and Edge Delivery Services (EDS), which power much of the web estate you will own.
  
  
Role Overview
  
You will work directly with affiliates, website owners, designers, account managers, Content Authors and front-end developers across multiple countries. You will understand what each market is trying to achieve, shape that into a clear product plan, and make sure it ships with the right quality and stays within policy.
  
This is a senior, hands-on role. You will own the outcomes of the sites you manage, from discovery and product definition through build, launch, adoption and continuous improvement. You will set patterns and standards that other teams can reuse, work with minimal supervision, and step in on the hardest technical problems rather than only directing them.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Product ownership and strategy
  
  

* Own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for your sites and web initiatives, aligned to affiliate and enterprise priorities.
* Discover real user and business needs, define problems clearly, and decide what is worth building, what to defer and what to say no to.
* Write and refine user stories with clear acceptance criteria, and prioritize based on value, effort, risk and compliance.
* Define success measures for each initiative and track outcomes such as adoption, performance, engagement and time to market.
* Make architectural and technology choices that balance speed, quality, cost and compliance in a regulated space.

Stakeholder and affiliate partnership
  
  

* Act as the primary partner for affiliates and website owners across countries, building trusted, long-term relationships.
* Intake and assess inbound requests for technical accuracy and feasibility, and set clear expectations on scope, effort and timelines.
* Communicate product direction, trade-offs and risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Collaborate with designers, account managers, content teams and governance partners so design, content and technology stay aligned.

Hands-on engineering
  
  

* Design and build features, or entire sites, using full-stack technologies (React or Vue with Node.js) and AEM Edge Delivery Services, with deep front-end expertise.
* Take on complex or ambiguous engineering problems yourself, including performance, integrations, accessibility and cross-browser issues.
* Prototype quickly, put working solutions in front of users and stakeholders early, and iterate on their feedback.
* Uphold code quality through standards, code reviews and automated testing, and release changes using CI/CD.
* Where it adds value, apply modern AI-assisted and automation approaches to improve the product and reduce manual effort.

AEM and Edge Delivery Services (EDS) platform
  
  

* Bring a strong understanding of the AEM platform, including authoring, assets, boilerplate and Sidekick, and use it to guide product and architecture decisions for your sites.
* Build and review AEM EDS web experiences, including custom blocks, using JavaScript, Node.js, HTML5 and CSS3, working with GitHub-based code and content workflows.
* Choose the right approach for each need (EDS, AEM sites or other solutions) and explain the trade-offs to affiliates and delivery teams.
* Partner with AEM developers and authors to establish reusable blocks, templates and authoring patterns that scale across markets.
* Drive performance, accessibility and SEO of AEM sites, including Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse scores.
* Own integrations that affect upstream and downstream systems, and ensure content, assets and delivery configuration (including Cloudflare where used) are set up correctly.

Delivery with the team
  
  

* Work with the development team to scope and estimate, assign work, monitor progress and remove blockers.
* Verify every release meets design, content and functional specification before it goes live.
* Ensure releases and deployments are smooth, with the ability to handle them independently when needed.

Site custodianship and governance
  
  

* Act as custodian of your sites: ensure they are built, validated, maintained and retired according to policy and procedure.
* Take change requests through the approval process, and ensure the approval PDF matches the live site.
* Ensure each site is in inventory, monitored appropriately, and meets all required policies and procedures.

Amazon Compliance Safety Services is looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Tech to own the compliance intelligence platform that powers how Amazon understands, structures, and applies regulatory requirements across global marketplaces. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:

Constantinople’s AI-native platform eliminates the need for expensive infrastructure, and replaces manual operational and compliance processes with AI at scale. By removing the operational complexity of banking, Constantinople enables our client banks to focus on their customers and the business of banking.
  
  
**The Role**
You will own the Payments product itself: the platform capability every client bank runs on, rather than the launch of any single client. Your job is to make Payments serviceable, manageable and competitive at scale across all of our client banks, current and future, as part of normal business-as-usual operation.
  
  
You will work closely with Software Engineering, Solution Engineering, Product Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance, and the Client Delivery team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Payments product roadmap and prioritisation.
* Own new Payments platform capability, including its timeline and delivery commitments. You will build it as reusable capability for all of our clients on the platform, including new payment rail integrations, for example NPP , PayTo and BECS bulk payments in Australia, and their equivalents in other jurisdictions.
* Own payment orchestration and routing logic, and bulk and batch payment processing.
* Build out the requirements for scheme and payment rail connectivity, and work with the Technology team in owning the technical architecture: adapter design per rail and country, gateway integrations, and how payment state is managed across the platform.
* Own the configuration model, which gathers the specifications needed to streamline implementation for each new client that joins the platform.
* Work with second line to continue to develop the fraud and risk control framework for Payments across jurisdictions, and own its implementation.
* Own the serviceability and management of Payments functionality at scale, with every process automated end to end so no manual processing is needed, supported by self-service tooling for Operations and, where appropriate, clients, and designed to work for both day-to-day operations and risk and compliance oversight.
* Own client-facing reporting that gives client banks everything they need to understand and run their own payments business, including reconciliation, settlement and transaction reporting available to all clients.
* Evolve the Payments offering to stay competitive with modern fintech payments providers, both for our current market position and as the market moves, while helping build a best-in-class Product team that values collaboration, meaningful work and impact.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with significant time on payments products.
* You have built payment rail integrations or payment platform capability, and know how scheme and rail connectivity works in practice.
* You have a background in payment processing systems, messaging standards such as ISO 20022, and API-based integrations.
* You have worked with second line to develop and implement fraud and financial crime controls for payment products.
* You have designed payment processes and tooling together with Operations and Risk and Compliance, and you understand the regulatory requirements for payments in the markets we serve.
* You have built reusable platform capability for multiple clients, supported by a configuration model that streamlines implementation for each new client.
* You have a bias toward action, a problem-solving mindset, and a willingness to do whatever it takes to solve complex challenges.

* You have a track record of driving alignment across technical teams, business partners and external vendors.
* You cut through ambiguity to produce strategic insight and spot opportunities.

* Experience building internal operations tooling.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is reinventing how organizations of every size buy, sell, and recover value — and Amazon India is on a fast-growing trajectory across three businesses: Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. That growth depends on one thing: India rapidly adopting the tools, platforms, and AI capabilities being built across the company, rather than rebuilding them. We are hiring a Seattle-based Senior Technical Program Manager to own that mission end to end.  
  
In this high-visibility role, you will be the single owner of capability alignment between India and the global teams that build Amazon's products, spanning Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. Sitting at the interface between India's businesses and the teams that build the roadmaps, you will ensure India is represented when new capabilities are designed, maintain a single view of capability adoption across all three lines of business, sequence the cross-organizational dependencies , and advocate for India's priorities in global planning.  
  
This is a rare front-row seat; You will work hand-in-hand with the teams building Amazon's newest business models and agentic AI products — from enterprise procurement and conversational commerce to intelligent, automated operations — gaining exposure to latest technology and go-to-market approaches before they scale, and shaping how they reach one of Amazon's most important growth markets.  
  
If you excel at influence without authority, thrive across organizational and geographic boundaries, and want a strategic mandate with executive visibility at the leading edge of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses, this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the capability-inclusion mechanism: Represent India in global product planning, requirements, and design reviews from the outset — converting today's informal, ad-hoc process into a governed, repeatable intake across all three businesses.  
  
Run a single view of capability adoption: Maintain source of truth for the full portfolio of tracked capabilities across the three businesses, with dependency maps and effort sizing, and represent it in global planning and review forums.  
  
Sequence cross-team dependencies: Untangle the multi-team dependency chains that cause launches to slip, coordinating across engineering, product, finance/compliance, and operations teams.  
  
Negotiate funding and execution ownership for India-specific customization work, including the last-mile localization required to bring global capabilities to market in India.  
  
Advocate for India's priorities in global planning, escalating structural blockers to the right leaders with clear, data-backed cases — particularly where India is deprioritized despite its strategic value.  
  
Establish the baseline and reporting that measure adoption progress and inform how the function scales over time.  
  
Partner deeply with the teams building Amazon's newest products and business models, ensuring India's needs are reflected early and that new capabilities reach the market efficiently.  
  
A day in the life  
You start your morning with AI as your co-pilot — using Amazon's internal generative-AI tools to scan overnight changes across the global product roadmaps for all three businesses, summarize what moved, and surface the handful of new capabilities where India isn't yet in the design conversation. What used to take an analyst days, you triage before your first meeting.  
  
Mid-morning, you join a working session with a product team building one of Amazon's newest AI-powered capabilities, aligning India into their next release so the market isn't left to catch up later. You then prepare for the executive review you own — a recurring leadership forum where you present the single view of capability adoption across the three businesses, call out risks and dependencies, and drive decisions with senior leaders on what India needs and when.  
  
In the afternoon, you unblock a stalled dependency: a global capability that needs a market-specific compliance change before India can adopt it. You get the owning teams and India's tech lead aligned on sequencing and funding, turning a multi-quarter stall into a committed plan. Alongside the day-to-day, you're steering the India launch of a multi-million-dollar product — coordinating engineering, finance, and operations across two continents to bring a capability to one of Amazon's most important growth markets.  
  
You close the day the way you opened it — with AI doing the heavy lifting: drafting an escalation, modeling a dependency sequence, and building the data-backed case for why a high-value capability should reach India sooner. You are not just adopting Amazon's AI tools; you are living at the frontier of how they change the way work gets done.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Are you ready to join the team of software engineering experts at Kyndryl? We are seeking a talented Software Engineering Technical Specialist to contribute to our software engineering space and provide critical skills required for the development of cutting-edge products.
  
  
As a Software Engineering Technical Specialist, you will Design, develop, and manage BI dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions. Integrate multiple data sources and ensure data consistency and accuracy. Support data-driven decision-making by creating actionable insights. Implement data governance, metadata management, and security practices. Provide predictive and prescriptive analytics for citizen services. Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and prioritize KPIs.

At Kyndryl, we value effective communication and collaboration skills. When you recognise opportunities for business change, you will have the ability to clearly and persuasively communicate complex technical and business concepts to both customers and team members. You’ll be the go-to person for problem-solving of customers’ business and technical issues. You have a knack for effectively identifying and framing problems, leading the collection of elements of information, and integrating this information to produce timely and thoughtful decisions. Your aim throughout, is to improve the effectiveness, efficiency and delivery of services through the use of technology and technical methods and methodologies.
  
  
Driving the design, development, integration, delivery, and evolution of highly scalable distributed software you will integrate with other layers and offerings. You will provide deeper functionality and solutions to address customer needs. You will work closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, and partner teams to get high-quality products and features through the agile software development lifecycle.
  
  
Your continuous grooming of features/user stories to estimate, identify technical risks/dependencies and clearly communicate them to project stakeholders will ensure the features are delivered with the right quality and within timeline. You will maintain and drive the clearing of technical debt, vulnerabilities, and currency of the 3rd party components within the product.
  
  
As a Software Engineering Technical Specialist, you will also coach and mentor engineers to design and implement highly available, secure, distributed software in a scalable architecture. This is an opportunity to make a real impact and contribute to the success of Kyndryl's innovative software products. Join us and become a key player in our team of software engineering experts!
  
  
Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* At least 4+ years in BI, data warehousing, and analytics solutions.
* B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/M.Sc in CS/IT/Statistics – 10+ years of experience.
* Hands on experience in statitistical libraries. Strong skills in Power BI/Tableau/Qlik, SQL, and ETL tools.
* Proficiency in data modeling, OLAP, and dashboard design.
* Experience in government data/large-scale citizen databases.

**Preferable Technical Expertise**

* Certification in BI/Analytics tools.
* Skilled in one or more of the following areas: Application Development, Data Platform, Security, Application Integration, Data Engineering, Server Systems, Packaged Application Implementation, Business Analysis, Network Systems, or Storage Systems
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field and/or Master Certified Technical Specialist  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. The Business Analyst will take ownership of assigned OMS workstreams, maintaining a holistic view of business processes, systems, integrations, and upstream and downstream dependencies.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**# About the team and the role**

  
  

**\*\*The Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) team\*\*** focuses on making selling on eBay simple, fast, and rewarding for everyday sellers, from listing and shipping to getting paid and selling again. C2C is a key growth engine for eBay: it brings unique inventory to the marketplace, and sellers who also buy drive significantly more demand across the platform. The team works to grow and retain the C2C seller base, improve selling velocity, and strengthen this buyer–seller flywheel.

  
  

**\*\*In this role\*\*** in the Indian Analytics Centre, you will be a hands-on analytics partner for C2C product initiatives. You will take well-scoped and moderately ambiguous product questions, break them down into clear analyses, and turn your findings into crisp insights and recommendations. Working closely with senior analysts and the analytics manager, you will build strong product and data depth in C2C and grow towards independently owning larger problem spaces. The role suits someone who is curious, self-driven, and eager to take ownership of their work.

  
  

**# What you will accomplish**

  
  

* Own analytics for defined C2C workstreams

  
  

* Measure how C2C product changes move core outcomes such as seller growth, listings, sold items, and incremental GMV, and help identify the levers that make C2C sellers more successful.

  
  

* Break down product and business questions into structured analyses with clear hypotheses and success metrics, with guidance on scoping for broader or more ambiguous problems.

  
  

* Use strong SQL and analytical rigour to analyse customer behaviour, product performance, feature adoption, funnels, and cohorts across large datasets.

  
  

* Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insights and recommendations for product managers and working teams, and contribute to narratives shared with senior stakeholders.

  
  

* Partner with product, engineering, design, and peer analytics teams on day-to-day questions, and keep stakeholders informed on progress, findings, and risks.

  
  

* Support measurement for product tests and launches, including defining metrics, building dashboards, monitoring performance, and diagnosing changes.

  
  

* Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that enable consistent performance tracking and self-service.

  
  

* Look beyond the immediate ask, flag anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities in the data, and bring them to the team with a point of view.

  
  

* Maintain high analytical quality by following clear metric definitions, validating data, documenting assumptions, and having work reviewed before it is shared.

  
  

**# What you will bring**

  
  

**## Required qualifications**

  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field.

  
  

* 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related role, ideally in a product or consumer technology setting.

  
  

* Strong hands-on SQL skills and experience analysing large, imperfect datasets with accuracy and attention to detail.

  
  

* Experience in product or business analytics, such as funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, feature adoption, segmentation, or performance measurement.

  
  

* Ability to build clear, user-friendly dashboards and data visualisations using BI or analytics tools.

  
  

* Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals and experiment measurement.

  
  

* Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to question assumptions and understand the real question behind an ask.

  
  

* Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, and to present analysis confidently to product and cross-functional partners.

  
  

* Self-driven and proactive working style, with a strong sense of ownership and the willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and move work forward.

  
  

* Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards for data quality and timely delivery.

  
  

* An AI-first mindset and interest in using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity and synthesis.

  
  

**## Good to have**

  
  

* Working knowledge of Python for exploratory analysis, automation, or prototyping.

  
  

* Exposure to causal inference or quasi-experimental methods.

  
  

* Experience with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools.

  
  

* Experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, seller or creator platforms, or consumer technology.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**About Loadshare:**

LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.

What sets us apart:

* Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.
* Strong financials, stronger ambition: With ₹800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.
* Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.
* Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day.
* Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.
* Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.

Founders/ Founding team:

* Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey
* Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi

We are hiring a Business Analyst to work closely with our leadership across operations, supply, finance, and business. Ideal for someone early in their career, looking to combine classic business analysis with modern AI-enabled problem-solving.

Business Data Analyst

Bangalore
