**About the role:**

Latinum is looking for an experienced Business Data Analyst for a client to drive end-to-end delivery of enterprise data, analytics, and reporting initiatives.

The role involves partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyse business processes and datasets, assess solution feasibility, and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications. You will work closely with Data Engineering and BI teams to deliver scalable data solutions on Azure, covering the complete SDLC from requirement gathering to deployment and production support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage with business stakeholders across multiple domains to gather, analyse, challenge, and document business requirements through workshops and discovery sessions.
* Perform business process analysis, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), and gap analysis to validate business rules, identify data quality issues, and define future-state solutions.
* Assess functional and technical feasibility, implementation approaches, dependencies, risks, and solution options.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, process flows, business rules, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and project documentation.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering and BI teams.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers throughout the SDLC to clarify requirements, track implementation, resolve functional issues, and ensure successful delivery.
* Write and optimise SQL queries on Azure Synapse and Salesforce staging data for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
* Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards, reports, and DAX measures for enterprise reporting and KPI tracking.
* Define and validate requirements for data integrations, reporting, automation, and data quality improvements.
* Coordinate SIT and UAT, manage defects, validate acceptance criteria, and obtain stakeholder sign-off.
* Support production deployments and post-production hypercare, coordinating issue resolution between business and technical teams.
* Maintain KPI definitions, data dictionaries, governance artefacts, and reporting standards while managing multiple initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Enterprise Reporting within large or complex organisations.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end requirements and delivery across discovery, analysis, documentation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong expertise in business process analysis, EDA, gap analysis, and technical feasibility assessments.
* Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in Azure Synapse Analytics or equivalent MPP/cloud data warehouse platforms.
* Advanced Power BI skills, including semantic modelling, DAX, dashboard development, and enterprise reporting.
* Good understanding of relational databases, ETL/ELT concepts, data modelling, source-to-target mappings, and data governance.
* Experience translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering teams.
* Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with Data Engineering teams.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
* Strong documentation skills, including BRDs, FRDs, process flows, and testing artefacts.
* Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Real Estate industry experience is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ideal Candidate: A strong Business Data Analyst who combines business requirements ownership, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, Azure data platform exposure, and end-to-end SDLC delivery experience.

jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Finance Innovation & Transformation (FIT) organization partners closely with FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and Technology teams to modernize financial planning, improve data transparency, and enable faster, more confident decision making across the enterprise.
  
  
FIT focuses on aligning planning processes, systems, and data to support scalable forecasting, accurate reporting, and operational excellence across Finance.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are seeking a Business Analyst – Finance Systems with a strong FP&A orientation to support the accuracy, reliability, and usability of eBay’s financial planning and reporting ecosystem. This role works across Anaplan, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and automation tools to ensure that Finance stakeholders have trusted data for planning, forecasting, and performance analysis.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of FP&A processes and financial systems, with demonstrated strength in auditing data, reconciling variances, and resolving reporting issues across integrated platforms.
  
  
What You Will Accomplish
  
  

* Support day‑to‑day operations of FP&A‑critical systems including Anaplan, SAP S/4HANA, and SAC, ensuring stable planning and reporting cycles
* Partner closely with FP&A teams during budgeting, forecasting, and outlook cycles, supporting data readiness, validation, and issue resolution
* Assist in the design, requirements and testing of Anaplan planning models, S4 implementations, & SAC reports, documenting requirements and test scripts, and testing to ensure implementation accuracy & success
* Perform end‑to‑end audits and reconciliations between planning, ERP, and reporting systems to ensure forecast and actuals alignment
* Investigate and explain plan vs. actual, forecast vs. forecast, and reporting variances, identifying root causes related to data, mappings, or system behavior
* Validate planning master data, hierarchies, drivers, and assumptions to ensure consistency across models and reports
* Support management and executive reporting by ensuring data accuracy, timing, and transparency
* Leverage automation, AI and analytics tools to streamline reconciliations, variance analysis, and validation checks, reducing manual effort
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) for planning model changes, system upgrades, and new integrations impacting FP&A processes
* Maintain validation reports, reconciliation frameworks, and documentation to support auditability and repeatable planning cycles
* Collaborate with Accounting, IT, and data teams to resolve integration, timing, and data quality issues affecting forecasts and reports
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on forecast accuracy, planning efficiency, and data trust

What You Will Bring
  
  

* 5+ years of experience supporting FP&A, finance systems, or financial planning and reporting processes
* Hands‑on experience with planning and reporting platforms such as Anaplan, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, or similar tools
* Solid experience in auditing, reconciling, and validating planning and actuals data across multiple systems
* Ability to analyze and resolve forecasting and reporting discrepancies with clear, finance‑based explanations
* Demonstrated expertise in FP&A processes, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
As a Business Analyst in Customer Entitlement Services, you will research customer inventories, prepare accurate license entitlements, and help improve the processes that support customer orders. You will work with Sales, Deal Management, Finance, Pricing, and Data Migration, communicate with requesters, and identify opportunities to simplify work through automation. This IC1 role is on the AMER shift.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Research customer inventories and details in Oracle systems, including Asset Report, PeopleSoft (HAT), and ROSIE, to prepare accurate Oracle Health entitlements and identify usage patterns or optimization opportunities.
* Migrate customers' existing license information accurately and on time in line with Oracle policies, helping customers manage licenses and supporting Sales and Deal Management activity.
* Work with Sales, Deal Management, Finance, Pricing, Data Migration, and PRG to resolve entitlement needs and help process customer orders efficiently.
* Serve as a primary contact for process inquiries, clarify requester requirements, and deliver requested entitlement summaries within agreed timelines.
* Analyze volumes and trends, apply analytical and statistical rigor to complex problems, and report findings that support management decisions and process improvement.
* Simplify and automate Customer Entitlement Services processes while building knowledge of Oracle policies, systems, and research tools and maintaining periodic core-process certification.
* Maintain working knowledge of Oracle policies, systems, and research tools, and complete periodic core-process certification to support consistent entitlement decisions.
* Independently build comprehensive customer entitlements with attention to the potential effects of licensing decisions on revenue, billing, and terminations.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Strong research, analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills for assessing customer inventories and producing accurate entitlement information.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, communicate clearly with requesters, and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently with limited direct supervision and deliver accurate summaries within required timelines.
* Ability to use data, volume trends, and analytical or statistical methods to support sound business decisions and process improvement.

**Good-to-Have**

* Familiarity with customer licensing, license migration, entitlements, or Oracle Cerner client inventories.
* Exposure to Asset Report, PeopleSoft (HAT), ROSIE, or comparable customer research systems.
* Understanding of pricing, quoting, booking, revenue recognition, invoicing, or related Sales and Finance processes.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Can I research customer inventories carefully and turn the findings into accurate entitlement information?
* Am I confident clarifying requester needs and coordinating with teams across Sales, Deal Management, Finance, Pricing, and Data Migration?
* Can I work independently, meet timelines, and maintain accuracy when preparing customer summaries?
* Can I analyze volume trends and apply sound analytical methods to improve processes and support decisions?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
